newsitem.title: CANADA: Molson to sell Reno-Depot stake.
newsitem.headline: Molson to sell Reno-Depot stake.

text.p: Molson Companies Ltd said on Monday that it intended to sell its stake in Reno-Depot Inc for C$62.25 million.

The Toronto-based brewing, sports and entertainment company said it owns 50 percent of a holding company that owns 90.2 percent of the shares of Reno-Depot. The Michaud family of Montreal owns the other half of the holding company.
Molson said Castorama S.A. of France offered to pay C$131.5 million or C$32.86 per Reno-Depot share for the 90.2 percent stake in Reno-Depot owned by Molson and the Michaud family.

Molson and the Michaud family agreed to offer their stakes in Reno-Depot for sale at the C$32.86 a share price to Home Depot Inc to satisfy an agreement that gave the U.S.-based home renovations retailer the right of first refusal on the sale of Reno-Depot shares.
Home Depot had 45 days to accept the offer before it would be considered to have refused its right to Reno-Depot shares. The sale to Castorama would then proceed, Molson said.
Under the terms of the offer, the purchaser was also required to make an offer for the 9.8 percent of the shares not held by Molson and the Michaud family.
Castorama intended to offer C$35.50 a share for those shares.
The deal was expected to be completed in April.
